accepted.rationale: Rebaseline-Rationale: s3w/dart, s3w/ode, s2r/dart, s2r/ode, s1p/dart, s1p/ode, s5a/dart, s5a/fcl, s5a/bullet, s5a/ode, gzb/ode, robot/dart, lcp, w1/dart, w1/ode, w64/dart, w64/ode, mt4-s3w/dart, mt4-s1p/dart: removing spdlog changes every benchmark's compile command, which each row's input hash includes; these rows stay within 1% Ir (largest +0.49% on s3w/dart) and their guards are unchanged.

Rebaseline-Rationale: pend/dart, dyn: under GCC 13.3 the smaller logging headers change inlining so that the articulated-inertia updates of single-DOF joints call Eigen's allFinite() out of line (pend/dart +2.56%, dyn +0.95% Ir); a function-level profile attributes 9,152 of pend/dart's 9,173 extra instructions per step to that call, and no logging code runs on these paths. GCC 15.2 on the same revision pair measures -0.06% and -0.07%. The fix (array().isFinite().all() at those checks) is in GenericJoint, which stays untouched while the step-path work lands, so it follows in its own PR.
